package.name: calibration
package.description: Calibration server node: loads the KITTI calibration files (camera intrinsics/distortion, velodyne->camera and imu->velodyne extrinsics), publishes sensor_msgs/CameraInfo for every camera and broadcasts the static TF tree (map -> odom -> base_link -> laser -> camera_link -> camera_optical_frame -> imu_link). Every later fusion stage consumes this.
